item.title: First phase of redevelopment project set to begin at the state fairgrounds
item.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (KRQE) – It's a "go" for a major first step in the fairgrounds redevelopment, with the special board in control of the property voting yes to pursue a list of projects. The green light is for what's called "Phase One" of the "master plan," which includes a new sports stadium, a park, housing, and more. item.title: Homicide investigation underway in northwest Albuquerque
item.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (KRQE) – Homicide detectives are investigating after a person was found dead at a northwest Albuquerque home on Monday.
